method: Built-in imagegen image editing, no external API/CLI
intent: Align newly drawn MotionPremium poses with existing three-head-tall SD Cless; retain existing pose order. Repair right-facing recovery sword direction.

entries.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / production character animation continuity repair. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: twenty sword-character action frames in a four-column, five-row transparent sprite sheet. Image 2 is the AUTHORITATIVE DESIGN REFERENCE for the SAME character's existing idle/attack animation. Redraw all 20 poses of Image 1 to match the precise character design and proportions of Image 2, so the game can cut between them without the head or body changing size/style. Match Image 2's approximately three-head-tall youthful SD proportions, smaller expressive brown eyes, detailed layered blond spikes, red bandana, slim articulated silver armor with gold edging, recognizable gold belt buckle, black underclothes, red cape and sword hilt. Avoid the overlarge round blue eyes, huge childlike head, squat two-head-tall chunky proportions and thick black cartoon outlines of Image 1. Keep crisp native detail; this is still stylized SD tactical RPG art. Pose/layout invariants: Preserve every Image 1 frame's facing, raised/lowered sword angle, hand side, leg stance and cape silhouette direction; there must be exactly 20 separate full-body figures, same four columns and five rows, positions correspond one-to-one. Columns face front/back/screen-right/screen-left. Do not replace poses with repeated idle pictures. Keep the same 1122x1402 transparent canvas, ample transparent gutters, every blade/cape/hair/boot fully inside its cell. Actual alpha background, no labels, no contact sheet border, no background shadows, no visual effects, no text. Output ONLY the revised Image 1 sheet; Image 2 is a style/identity reference, never part of the output.
